pages.text: Sant the ant felt hot and flat.

Sant the ant felt bad. He had
to stop on the spot and rest.

Sant had to drop to his soft
bed.
Sant the ant did not get up.

Sant was ill. His dad had to
come and hand Sant a drink.

Sant had to grab the cup and
swig his drink a lot.

Sant had to flop on his snug
bed for a rest. He was still
not well.

Sant is not ill! He is glad to
get up from bed.
